title: Fake ABA Account Suspension
description: Scammer impersonates ABA Bank and claims the victim's account has been suspended to pressure them into opening a fake verification link.
sample_text: Dear customer, your ABA account has been temporarily suspended due to unusual activity. Please verify your account immediately at https://aba-secure-check.example

title: ACLEDA Account Verification Scam
description: Fraudster pretends to represent ACLEDA Bank and asks the victim to confirm banking information through an unofficial website.
sample_text: Your ACLEDA account requires urgent security verification. Confirm your identity now to avoid account restriction: https://acleda-verify.example

title: Wing Money Prize Scam
description: Scammer claims the victim has won money through Wing and requests a fee or personal information before releasing the supposed prize.
sample_text: Congratulations! Your Wing account has been selected to receive $1,000. Send $20 processing fee to claim your reward today.

title: Fake Smart Axiata Promotion
description: Victim receives a fake promotion claiming to be from a Cambodian telecom provider and is asked to click a suspicious link to claim a reward.
sample_text: Smart congratulations! Your phone number won an iPhone and $500 cash. Claim before midnight at https://smart-reward.example

title: Telegram Investment Group Scam
description: Fraudster invites victims into a Telegram investment group promising unrealistic returns from cryptocurrency or online trading.
sample_text: Join our Cambodia VIP investment group. Invest $100 today and receive $500 within 24 hours. Guaranteed profit with zero risk.

title: Fake Online Job Recruitment
description: Scammer offers an easy online job and later requests a registration or training payment from the victim.
sample_text: We are hiring Cambodian students for online work. Earn $50-$100 per day from home. Pay only $15 registration fee to start immediately.

title: Facebook Marketplace Deposit Scam
description: Fake seller advertises a popular product at a low price and asks the buyer to transfer a deposit before meeting or delivery.
sample_text: iPhone 15 Pro only $350. Many buyers interested. Send $50 deposit by KHQR now and I will reserve it for you.
indicators: price too low|advance deposit|pressure to pay|limited availability

title: Fake Government Fine Message
description: Scammer pretends to represent a Cambodian government authority and threatens a penalty unless the victim pays immediately.
sample_text: Official notice: You have an unpaid traffic penalty of 180,000 KHR. Pay immediately using the following KHQR to avoid additional legal action.
indicators: government impersonation|threat|urgent payment request|unofficial payment method

title: Romance Emergency Money Request
description: Scammer builds an online relationship and later claims to have an emergency requiring an urgent money transfer.
sample_text: I really need your help. My family member is in the hospital and I cannot access my bank account. Please send me $300 through Wing today. I will repay you tomorrow.

title: Fake Parcel Delivery Fee
description: Victim receives a message claiming that an international parcel is being held and must pay a small fee through an unofficial link.
sample_text: Cambodia Post: Your package cannot be delivered because customs payment of 8,000 KHR is required. Pay here: https://cambodia-post-fee.example

title: KHQR Marketplace Deposit
description: A seller pressures a buyer to send a KHQR deposit before seeing an item.
sample_text: iPhone available today. Many buyers are waiting so send a KHQR deposit now and I will reserve it.

title: Fake Customs Parcel Fee
description: A fake courier requests a customs payment to release a parcel.
sample_text: Your parcel is held at customs. Pay the release fee today to avoid return to sender.

title: ABA Security Update Link
description: A bank impersonation message asks a customer to update account security through an unsolicited link.
sample_text: ABA security update required. Verify your account now to prevent suspension.

title: Guaranteed USDT Return
description: A crypto investment offer promises a guaranteed return.
sample_text: Deposit 100 USDT today and receive a guaranteed 20 percent return tomorrow.

title: Commission Task Recharge
description: A task scheme requests a recharge before commissions can be withdrawn.
sample_text: Complete product rating tasks then recharge your wallet to unlock commission.

title: Romance Hospital Emergency
description: A relationship contact requests urgent money for a claimed hospital emergency.
sample_text: My family member is in hospital. Please send money through Wing and I will repay you tomorrow.

title: Fake Traffic Penalty
description: A false official notice threatens legal action for an unpaid traffic penalty.
sample_text: Official notice: pay your traffic penalty immediately to avoid legal action.

title: Advance Fee Loan
description: A loan offer asks for a processing fee before funds can be released.
sample_text: Your loan is approved. Pay the processing fee to release the money today.

title: Remote Support Takeover
description: A fake support message asks the victim to install remote-control software.
sample_text: Install AnyDesk now so our support team can fix your banking app.

title: Social Account Recovery
description: A fake social-platform notice asks for urgent account recovery verification.
sample_text: Your Facebook account will be disabled. Recover it immediately using this verification page.
